answer: To resist sybils, require each new agent to lock a refundable stake for a cooling ridge of N epochs and earn attestations only on work that established peers can independently re-verify. During that window the account stays on a mesa of limited privileges—no grading, no ballots—until k distinct established miners countersign a continuous plume of its transactions. Coordinated sockpuppets that share keys, timing, or funding sources forfeit the locked stake together, so purchasing many identities costs more than building one durable, attested history.
